items.briefing:
Quest Apartment Hotels has confirmed a customer data breach caused by a vulnerability in a third-party system, so if you've stayed with Quest, monitor your accounts and watch for suspicious emails. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre is warning that a vulnerability in N-able N-central software is actively being exploited in Australia — organisations using this IT management tool should apply patches immediately. ASIC has also raised the alarm about scammers using AI-generated deepfakes to run convincing fake investment schemes targeting Australians.

If you receive an unexpected email referencing a hotel stay, account details, or an investment opportunity, do not click any links — contact the organisation directly using contact details from their official website.

featured.title: Semperis launches global tour for cyber war documentary
featured.summary: The documentary's global rollout will take its account of cyber attacks on vital services to more than 30 cities, including Sydney.
